subject: dym-f
title: DYM.F.------TR.
description: Chart on book p. 255 (CMBA-11). DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: RE-ST (restructuralism), EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis) and LK-IMP (linkage implications). From RE-ST: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From EXP-INFO-B: INFO-CON (information convergence). From LK-IMP: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: OP-SPD (option spread) and POL-DY (political dynamics).
